ORION CLOUD PLATFORM — MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
Parties: Orion Materials Group plc and LumenGrid Systems SAS.
Effective date: 2027-04-03.
Annual platform fee: EUR 61,400, billed in two equal instalments.
The annual security review budget is EUR 61,900 and is separate from the platform fee.

TERM, RENEWAL AND NOTICE
The agreement renews on 2028-04-03 unless a party gives written notice at least 30 days before renewal.

SECURITY EVENTS
LumenGrid shall notify Orion of a confirmed cybersecurity incident within 36 hours after confirmation.
The incident clock begins at confirmation, not when the first service alert appears.

PRODUCTION ACCESS
No subcontractor may access Orion production data before Orion gives prior written approval.

SERVICE DESK
For a routine service request, LumenGrid targets an initial response within four business hours. This service-desk target is not an incident-notification deadline.

ORION CLOUD PLATFORM — DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM
This addendum applies to personal data processed by LumenGrid for Orion under the Master Services Agreement.

PERSONAL-DATA BREACH NOTICE
For a confirmed personal-data breach, LumenGrid shall notify Orion within 18 hours after discovery.
The parties did not record whether this addendum replaces or takes precedence over the cybersecurity-incident notice term in the Master Services Agreement.

RETENTION
Exported personal data must be deleted within 30 days after termination, subject to a documented legal hold.

ORION CLOUD PLATFORM — SERVICE INCIDENT REPORT
Incident date: 2027-06-14. The gateway began dropping dispatch acknowledgements at 09:10 UTC. Service was restored at 09:28 UTC, so the interruption lasted 18 minutes.
The report distinguishes the 18-minute service interruption from notification duties in the signed agreements.

CUSTOMER FOLLOW-UP
The operations team set an internal target to update affected customers within 72 hours. This is an operational target, not an amendment to the Master Services Agreement.
This incident report does not amend the Master Services Agreement.
At report approval, the review had not established a personal-data breach. No customer compensation amount or named notification recipient is stated in this report.

FICHE FOURNISSEUR — RIVAGE ARCHIVE SERVICES
La présente fiche a été validée le 1er mai 2027 pour les services d’archivage de Rivage Archive Services.
Le stockage standard est facturé 2 100 EUR par mois. Une option de restauration express coûte 2 190 EUR par intervention; elle ne fait pas partie du tarif mensuel standard.

SUIVI CONTRACTUEL
Date de renouvellement contractuel : non consignée.
Identifiant TVA : non fourni dans le dossier reçu.
Les exports temporaires sont supprimés dans les 45 jours suivant la fin du contrat.
